claims: FHA loans are government-backed mortgages insured by the Federal Housing Administration.
FHA loans allow down payments as low as 3.5%.
FHA loans have credit score requirements typically 580 or higher.
FHA loan down payment is 3.5% for credit scores of 580 or higher.
FHA loan down payment is 10% for credit scores between 500-579.
FHA loans require an upfront Mortgage Insurance Premium fee of 1.75%.
FHA loans require annual Mortgage Insurance Premium premiums of 0.45% to 1.05%.
FHA loan annual MIP is required for the life of the loan.
FHA loan annual MIP is required for 11 years if a 10% down payment is made.
FHA loan properties must be a primary residence.
FHA loan properties must pass a stricter appraisal for health and safety.
The floor for FHA loan limits in 2026 in lower-cost areas is $541,287.
The ceiling for FHA loan limits in 2026 in high-cost areas is $1,249,125.
FHA loans generally allow applicants 2 years post-Chapter 7 bankruptcy.
FHA loans generally allow applicants 3 years post-foreclosure.
FHA loans have assumable mortgages.
FHA Fixed-Rate Mortgage is a standard purchase loan.
FHA 203(k) Loan is for purchasing and rehabilitating or renovating a home.
HECM is a reverse mortgage for seniors 62+.
FHA Energy Efficient Mortgage is to add energy-saving improvements.
FHA Streamline Refinance is simple refinancing for existing FHA loans.
